# Vendored pklr

Source: pklr 5.2.3, upstream commit `59ed0fd92b540db58205d98b940a66ead2a702ae`, MIT licensed. The source includes the resource-capability changes through commit `576547e4c5a868c11d3cf0bdbfb5569821f139fd` in `https://github.com/donbeave/pklr`: separate resource hooks, output-aware JSON evaluation, and capability-backed glob traversal. The vendored copy keeps builds independent of Git dependencies. Upstream test targets and dev-only dependencies are omitted; fork tests are maintained upstream of this snapshot.
